apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
New
- Away from home on iPhone and iPad, as in the Android, Mac and Windows apps: Tuna reaches your server through WireGuard, built in and used only by Tuna, with no VPN to switch on. Set it up in Settings → Away from home with the device's WireGuard .conf file. Needs iOS 17 or later. - Pages, songs, the songs kept ahead and downloads all go through it. Away from home, downloads carry on while Tuna is running (playing music keeps it running). - Installing with Xcode now also needs Go (brew install go).

Fixed
- Away from home: the WireGuard .conf file couldn't be chosen on iPhone and iPad (it was greyed out). Any file can be chosen now, and Tuna says if it isn't a WireGuard file.

To update: the server (pull the new image) and the iPhone app.
